Overview.Name: Viswanath Sarma
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Early_Morning (optional): Option 1: Warm water (200 ml) + lemon water
Option 2: Warm water (200 ml) + soaked almonds (6 nos)
Option 3: Warm water (200 ml) + fruit (100 g)
Breakfast: Option 1: Poha (80 g) with vegetables (50 g) + curd (100 g)
Option 2: Vegetable upma (80 g) + small bowl curd (100 g)
Lunch: Option 1: Plain rice (150 g) + dal (150 g) + vegetable curry (100 g)
Option 2: Chapati (2) + paneer curry (150 g) + dal (100 g)
Option 3: Millet khichdi (150 g) with vegetables (100 g) + curd (100 g)
Evening_Snack: Option 1: Fruit (100 g) + green tea (200 ml)
Dinner: Option 1: Dal (180 g) + vegetable curry (120 g) + salad (50 g)
Option 3: Light vegetable soup (250 ml) + millet roti (2 small)

Notes_and_Tips: For hypertension: keep salt very moderate and avoid pickles and processed foods.
Control portion sizes, especially rice and fried foods.
Include dal and paneer as protein sources for satiety.
Prefer steamed or grilled options; avoid deep-fried snacks.
Aim for a short walk after meals when possible.
Keep meals regular to support blood pressure and energy.
